moments.title: England vs Spain: UEFA Nations League Final Match
moments.blurb: England faces Spain tonight in Madrid for their final UEFA Nations League group stage match, a crucial game for national pride and qualification hopes.

angles.name: Match Day Hype
angles.copy: It's England vs Spain tonight! The Three Lions are in Madrid for their final Nations League showdown. Who's watching? #England

angles.name: Pre-Match Buzz
angles.copy: Big game for England tonight! They take on Spain in the Nations League. Can they finish the group stage strong? Kick-off 7:45pm.

angles.name: National Pride
angles.copy: Come on England! Tonight's the night for Gareth Southgate's squad to show what they're made of against Spain. Get behind the lads!

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! Returns
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated new series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! kicks off tomorrow night on ITV1, with Ant & Dec returning to Australia for the 26th series featuring a host of new celebrities including Wayne Rooney, Joanna Page, and Kaiser Chiefs frontman Ricky Wilson.

angles.name: Launch Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! starts tomorrow night on ITV1 at 9pm. Who are you backing for King or Queen of the Jungle?

angles.name: Confirmed Line-up Tease
angles.copy: Wayne Rooney, Joanna Page, Ricky Wilson... the I'm A Celeb line-up is looking HUGE! Catch all the jungle action from tomorrow at 9pm.

angles.name: Welsh Connection
angles.copy: Our very own Joanna Page is heading into the I'm A Celeb jungle tomorrow night! Tune in to ITV1 at 9pm to see how she fares in the challenges. #Wales

moments.title: Jamie Miller Holds UK Singles Chart Number 1
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' continues its reign at the top of the UK Official Singles Chart this week, fending off competition from Tate McRae and Ashe.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at #1! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' isn't budging from the top spot on the Official Singles Chart. Is it your favourite right now?

angles.name: Pop Power
angles.copy: Jamie Miller continues to dominate the UK charts with 'Babydoll'. A true pop anthem!

moments.title: Anni-Frid Lyngstad of ABBA Turns 81
moments.blurb: Happy 81st birthday to Anni-Frid Lyngstad, one of the iconic vocalists from Swedish pop legends ABBA, born today in 1945.

angles.name: ABBA Icon
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the incredible Anni-Frid Lyngstad from ABBA, who turns 81 today! What's your favourite ABBA track?

angles.name: Frida's Day
angles.copy: From 'Dancing Queen' to 'The Winner Takes It All', Anni-Frid Lyngstad's voice is legendary. Happy 81st to ABBA's Frida!

moments.title: Petula Clark Celebrates 94th Birthday
moments.blurb: British singing legend Petula Clark, known for hits like 'Downtown' and 'Colour My World', celebrates her 94th birthday today, born in 1932.

angles.name: British Legend
angles.copy: Happy 94th Birthday to the iconic Petula Clark! A true British treasure whose voice has graced the charts for decades. What's your favourite Petula track?

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: 'Downtown' and beyond! Celebrating the incredible career of Petula Clark on her 94th birthday today.

moments.title: Philomena Cunk Returns with 'Cunk on Cinema' on Netflix
moments.blurb: Diane Morgan's beloved satirical character Philomena Cunk is back, with 'Cunk on Cinema' premiering today on Netflix, offering her unique take on the history of film.

angles.name: Cunk's Back
angles.copy: She's back! Philomena Cunk is taking on the world of film in 'Cunk on Cinema', streaming from today on Netflix. Prepare for some profound insights (and laughs).

angles.name: Netflix Comedy
angles.copy: Need a laugh? 'Cunk on Cinema' with Diane Morgan is out today on Netflix. Get ready to learn absolutely nothing, brilliantly.

angles.name: Football's Back

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive weekend of Premier League action! Man City, Chelsea, Arsenal, Liverpool, Man Utd all in action. Who's picking up 3 points?

moments.title: Cardiff City & Swansea City in Championship Action

moments.title: Joe Walsh of The Eagles Turns 79

angles.name: Rock Royalty

angles.copy: From 'Life's Been Good' to 'Hotel California', Joe Walsh's influence is undeniable. Celebrating his 79th this Wednesday!

moments.title: Norman Greenbaum, 'Spirit in the Sky' Singer, Turns 84

angles.name: One-Hit Wonder Icon
angles.copy: Got that 'Spirit in the Sky'! Happy 84th Birthday to Norman Greenbaum, whose iconic track still sounds fresh today. What a tune!

angles.name: Timeless Classic
angles.copy: On November 20th, we celebrate Norman Greenbaum's 84th birthday. His legacy is truly heavenly!

moments.title: Björk Celebrates 61st Birthday
moments.blurb: The hugely influential and distinctive Icelandic artist Björk, known for her experimental music and captivating visuals, turns 61 on November 21st.

angles.name: Unique Visionary

angles.name: Icelandic Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible talent of Björk on her birthday this Thursday! From The Sugarcubes to her solo masterpieces, a legend.
